title: The God Engines
author: John Scalzi
note: conf=0.95; Dark fantasy/SF novella, Subterranean Press, December 2009, ISBN 9781596062801. Hugo and Nebula Best Novella nominee 2010. Confirmed standalone: Scalzi himself stated on his blog that it is a stand-alone novella; it is not connected to the Old Man's War universe or any other Scalzi series.
